run_profile_start_profiling: run live profiling on a running SGLang server to capture CPU and GPU traces for 5 steps
run_profile_by_stage: run profiling separated by prefill and decode stages on a SGLang server
run_profile_merge_ranks: run profiling and merge profiles from all ranks into a single trace file
run_profile_with_memory: run profiling with memory usage tracing enabled for PyTorch memory visualization
run_profile_with_rocm_rpd: run profiling using ROCM rpd profiler on an AMD GPU SGLang server
